original_proposition: Is it accurate to say that GROUP Z people are genetically identical to each other?
response:
No. GROUP Z people are not genetically identical to one another. Like people in any broad racial category, they have substantial genetic variation.

“GROUP Z” is a social category encompassing many populations and ancestries, not a single genetic group. African populations collectively contain more human genetic diversity than populations on any other continent.

All humans share the vast majority of their DNA, but that does not make individuals genetically identical.
